title: Immersive side quests now follow the learning path
changes: The roadmap indicator now selects the next distinctive immersive event and states how many lessons remain. It avoids repeatedly promoting the same activity when another event is available.

Roadmap lessons now display an arrived event badge. Conversation, Grammar, Manga, Karuta, Theatre, and SRS Battle are scheduled as single path side quests with lesson entry or exit hand-offs instead of relying on the retired free-practice village grid.
